notes: The guide's Sources note says installed jfs-components 0.1.78 (5 October build), checked 8 October 2026; the evidence's latest check is at 0.1.78-636f3f5 on 8 October, so Sources citations carry that build. The installed build is now 0.1.78-c1fa197 (13 October) and the evidence has no IconButton check on it. The evidence's first sections (28 September, 0.1.60) describe toggle bugs that its 0.1.78 check records as fixed (#172: the On state now uses the toggle tokens, aria-pressed follows isActive, and the derived name no longer changes), and a click focus ring that the 636f3f5 check records as fixed (#179); only the fixed behaviour is used here. The 0.1.60 contract says loading renders a skeleton only inside SkeletonGroup, while the installed types describe loading as a per-instance override that otherwise inherits from SkeletonGroup; the evidence was not re-checked, so the loading state is taken from the guide and no evidence fact is recorded. The guide names no other component to use instead and gives no avoid-when guidance, so avoidWhen is empty. The required accessibility rule rests on the Sources sentence "so always set one", which has no condition.

evidenceFacts.name: accessibilityLabel
evidenceFacts.description: Without it, the name is derived from the icon (ic_flash gives “Flash”); a toggle keeps the same derived name in both states.
evidenceFacts.quote: `aria-pressed` follows `isActive`, and the derived name stays "Flash" in both states; 0.1.77 changed it to "Flash Off".

evidenceFacts.name: isActive
evidenceFacts.description: On a toggle, the On state reads the toggle tokens (white fill in Light), and aria-pressed follows isActive on the web.
evidenceFacts.quote: #172 fixed. Toggle On reads `toggleIconButton/*` through the `isActive` True/False modes.

evidenceFacts.name: Button / Size
evidenceFacts.description: M renders 40 × 40 (Figma 42 × 42); S and XS both render 26 × 26 with a 16 px icon.
evidenceFacts.quote: M: 40 × 40 (Figma 42 × 42; the 1 px border is drawn inside on the web). S and XS: 26 × 26 with a 16 px icon.
